subject.title: fix: anchor JSON Schema patterns for llama.cpp HTTP server compatibility

question: How should OpenClaw identify llama.cpp before applying its nonstandard pattern requirement to tool schemas?
rationale: The reported provider uses an arbitrary custom ID and LAN URL, so neither network locality nor a fixed provider-name list safely identifies llama.cpp; maintainers must choose the durable compatibility contract.

options.title: Explicit schema profile
options.body: Add a llama.cpp value to the existing `toolSchemaProfile` compatibility seam and document it for arbitrary custom provider configurations.

options.title: Known provider IDs only
options.body: Enable the behavior only for recognized llama.cpp provider aliases, accepting that custom IDs require separate configuration or documentation.

options.title: Drop pattern constraints
options.body: Use the existing unsupported-keyword compatibility path to remove `pattern` from llama.cpp-bound schemas instead of rewriting its semantics.

recommendation.title: Explicit schema profile
recommendation.body: Add a llama.cpp value to the existing `toolSchemaProfile` compatibility seam and document it for arbitrary custom provider configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this contributor to the tool-schema compatibility and projection boundary that would own the chosen contract.
